description: This file contains internal implementation details for string formatting in the Abseil C++ library, including classes and functions for binding format arguments, converting and processing format specifications, and outputting formatted strings.

classes.name: ArgContext
classes.description: Helper class to bind format arguments to format specifications.

classes.name: DefaultConverter
classes.description: Default implementation for converting and outputting formatted data.

classes.name: SummarizingConverter
classes.description: Converter that summarizes formatted arguments into a string.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds an unbound conversion to a format argument, resolving width, precision, and flags.

methods.name: ConvertAll
methods.description: Converts all format specifications using a provided converter.
